topArticle.title: Canada’s retaliatory US tariffs take effect as trade dispute grows
topArticle.description:
Counter-measures covering several sectors come after Trump announced 50% tariffs on Canadian goods 
Canada’s retaliatory tariffs on billions of dollars’ worth of American imports have come into effect, escalating a trade fight that has been marked by intensifying tensions between the US president, Donald Trump, and the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney.
The tariffs took effect at 12.01am on Tuesday, and range from 15% to 50% and apply to products covering $20bn in imports from the US. The measures target sectors including steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics – industries that have been most affected by US tariffs.

topArticle.title: Hijacking pirates exploit regional chaos to return to seas off Somalia
topArticle.description:
US-Israel war on Iran and political instability in Somalia lead to pirates targeting cargo ships off Horn of Africa
The scourge of Somali piracy targeting cargo ships and smaller dhows off the Horn of Africa has returned to levels not seen in a decade, driven by a convergence of factors including disruptions to the shipping industry caused by the US-Israeli war against Iran and a resurgence of political instability in Somalia.
Since late April there have been eight hijackings by Somali pirates, including two within the space of a fortnight in August: one targeting an oil tanker with ties to Iran, the other a Cameroon-flagged vessel, the Lutuf, carrying military equipment for Turkey.

topArticle.title: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
topArticle.description:
Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat
Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people.
Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing.

topArticle.title: Sharpeville massacre survivors start legal fight for justice in South Africa
topArticle.description: At least 69 people were shot dead in 1960 but no-one has been prosecuted and victims want restitution.
topArticle.titleJa: シャープビル虐殺の生存者が南アフリカで正義を求める法的闘争を開始
topArticle.summary: 1960年のシャープビル虐殺で殺害された69人の犠牲者のため、生存者らが南アフリカで法的措置を取り、賠償を求めている。

topArticle.title: Cameroon’s indomitable Lionesses football team finally shatter WAFCON glass ceiling
topArticle.description: After losing three finals, the Cameroonian women’s team finally lifted the Women’s Africa Cup of Nations. Their 3–0 victory over Malawi demonstrates this generation’s perseverance and progressive transformation in African women’s football.
topArticle.titleJa: カメルーンの不屈の女子サッカーチーム、ついにWAFCONのガラスの天井を打ち破る
topArticle.summary: カメルーンの女子サッカーチームが3度の決勝敗退を経て、ついに女子アフリカネイションズカップで優勝。アフリカ女子サッカーの進歩を示す快挙。

topArticle.title: Indigenous plants offer Ghanaians an alternative to costly Western medicine
topArticle.description: About 60 to 70 percent of the Ghanaian population depends on the traditional medicine market for their medical care, according to a 2023 study in Frontiers in Pharmacology.
topArticle.titleJa: ガーナの在来植物が高価な西洋医学の代替手段を提供
topArticle.summary: ガーナ人口の60～70%が伝統医療に依存。在来植物が高価な西洋医学に代わる医療の選択肢となる現状を紹介。

topArticle.title: The devastating impact of copper and cobalt mining pollution in Lualaba, DRC
topArticle.description: The slogan 'DRC, a solution country' to the energy transition is merely a facade, masking the mining pollution that destroys the environment and human lives alike.
topArticle.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国ルアラバ州における銅・コバルト採掘による汚染の壊滅的な影響
topArticle.summary: コンゴ民主共和国ルアラバ州での銅・コバルト採掘が深刻な環境汚染と人命破壊を引き起こしている実態を報告。「解決策の国」というスローガンは欺瞞。

topArticle.title: Mozambique: Women, capulana dresses, and police violence stand out at Nampula protests
topArticle.description: Women in Nampula turned the capulana into a symbol of resistance, while social media amplified protests, digital activism, and debates regarding state control and civic rights in Mozambique.
topArticle.titleJa: モザンビーク：ナンプラの抗議デモで女性、カプラナドレス、警察の暴力が際立つ
topArticle.summary: モザンビークのナンプラでの抗議デモでは、女性たちがカプラナドレスを抵抗の象徴とし、警察の暴力や市民権に関する議論が活発化した。

topArticle.title: 'Tirana teeth': Albania hopes to be the new Turkey for dental work
topArticle.description: The Balkan nation is aiming to become a new centre for medical tourism.
topArticle.titleJa: 「ティラナの歯」：アルバニアが歯科治療でトルコに代わる存在を期待
topArticle.summary: バルカン半島の国アルバニアが、歯科治療を含む医療ツーリズムの新たな中心地となることを目指している。

topArticle.title: Ecclestone stopped by police for taking shotgun into Portugal
topArticle.description: Former Formula 1 boss Bernie Ecclestone says he was stopped by officials at an airport in Portugal after arriving with a shotgun he intended to use in a clay pigeon shooting competition.
topArticle.titleJa: エクレストン氏、散弾銃をポルトガルに持ち込み警察に止められる
topArticle.summary: 元F1ボス、バーニー・エクレストン氏が、クレー射撃大会で使用する散弾銃を持ってポルトガルの空港に到着した際、当局に止められたと語った。

topArticle.title: Austria's Islamic headscarf ban in force as under-14s go back to school
topArticle.description: The government says the law is intended to protect the rights of young girls, but critics say it is fuelling anti-Muslim feeling.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストリア、14歳未満のイスラム教徒のヘッドスカーフ禁止法が発効、新学期開始
topArticle.summary: オーストリアで14歳未満のイスラム教徒の女子生徒に対するヘッドスカーフ禁止法が施行された。政府は権利保護のためとするが、批判派は反イスラム感情を煽ると指摘。

topArticle.title: Taylor crowns boxing career in stylish Croke Park triumph
topArticle.description: Katie Taylor ends illustrious career as a three-time undisputed world champion as Croke Park gave one of Ireland's greatest sporting figures the grandest of farewells.
topArticle.titleJa: テイラー、クローク・パークでの見事な勝利でボクシングキャリアを飾る
topArticle.summary: ケイティ・テイラーは、アイルランドの偉大なスポーツ選手の一人として、クローク・パークで華々しい引退を迎え、3度の世界統一王者として輝かしいキャリアを終えた。

topArticle.title: Tate brothers officially indicted with trafficking and sex crimes in Romania
topArticle.description: Andrew and Tristan Tate are currently in a Miami jail fighting extradition to the UK over separate charges and deny all the allegations.
topArticle.titleJa: テイト兄弟、ルーマニアで人身売買と性犯罪で正式に起訴される
topArticle.summary: アンドリューとトリスタン・テイト兄弟がルーマニアで人身売買と性犯罪の容疑で正式に起訴された。彼らは現在マイアミの刑務所にいるが、全ての容疑を否認。

topArticle.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
topArticle.description: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.
topArticle.titleJa: ボリビア軍兵舎での爆発で少なくとも2人死亡
topArticle.summary: ボリビアのビアチャにある軍兵舎で爆発が発生し、少なくとも2人が死亡。当局は死者数の増加を懸念し、さらなる爆発の危険があるため住民に接近を控えるよう警告している。

topArticle.title: Remarkable US oil deal puzzles analysts - and angers many Venezuelans
topArticle.description: Amounting to 65 billion barrels of crude, the deal is labelled by one ex-envoy as a colonialist "fever dream".
topArticle.titleJa: 驚くべき米国の石油取引、アナリストを困惑させ、多くのベネズエラ人を怒らせる
topArticle.summary: 650億バレル相当の米国との石油取引が、アナリストを困惑させ、多くのベネズエラ人の怒りを買っている。元特使は植民地主義的と批判。

topArticle.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
topArticle.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
topArticle.titleJa: 政治的・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民殺害が増加
topArticle.summary: 政治的・経済的圧力により、ブラジルでは先住民に対する暴力が増加。土地の権利問題や境界設定への圧力が、殺害事件の増加につながっている。

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民権を武器にする：ニカラグアでの異議申し立てを封じる
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアでは、権威主義的な政権が市民権剥奪を正当化する言説を用いて、国民の異議申し立てを封じ込めている実態を検証する。

topArticle.title: Indonesia airports reopen after volcano eruption leaves 340,000 stranded
topArticle.description: Anak Krakatau, which lies about 150km from Jakarta, began spewing lava and volvanic ash late on Friday.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシアの空港、火山噴火で34万人が足止め後再開
topArticle.summary: アナク・クラカタウ火山の噴火により閉鎖されていたインドネシアの空港が再開。34万人以上が足止めされていた。

topArticle.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice
topArticle.description: On 2 September 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 31 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of hulled rice, semi-whitened or whitened rice, polished or glazed, and broken rice.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の種類の米に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 2026年9月2日、マダガスカルは特定の種類の米の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を8月31日に開始したとWTOに通知。国内市場保護が目的。
